serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: The Flare Platform is a cloud-based external threat intelligence, digital risk protection, and cybersecurity monitoring platform that helps organizations identify, monitor, and mitigate cyber threats originating from external sources. It collects, analyzes, and correlates threat intelligence from the clear web, dark web, and other publicly accessible and restricted online sources to provide continuous visibility into an organization's external attack surface, including compromised credentials, exposed data, brand impersonation, phishing activity, and threat actor discussions. The platform provides automated threat detection, alerting, investigation, workflow management, reporting, and analytics to support security operations teams and ongoing cybersecurity risk management. The platform is hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and is delivered to customers as a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solution.

overallSummaryOfAssessment: Thoropass Assurance (Arlington, Virginia; Firm License No. PAC-FIRM-LIC-134618) performed a SOC 2 Type II examination of the Flare Platform, operated by Flare Systems, Inc., for the period June 1, 2025 to May 31, 2026, covering the Security Trust Services Criteria. The examination resulted in an unqualified opinion with no exceptions noted; one control (security incident logging, tracking, and communication) was not tested due to no security incidents occurring during the period. Amazon Web Services (AWS) was presented as a subservice organization under the carve-out method. Independent verification and validation of Flare's security controls (per FRC-CLA-MFR/IVV-CSX-AIA) is satisfied through Flare's annual SOC 2 Type II examination.

certified.useCase: Amazon Web Services (AWS). Primary cloud infrastructure provider hosting the Flare Platform, including Amazon EC2 and Amazon EKS (compute and container orchestration), Amazon ECR (container registry), Amazon RDS, Amazon S3, and Amazon EBS (data storage, including self-managed Cassandra and Elasticsearch data stores), Amazon VPC, AWS Security Groups, and Amazon Route 53 (network segmentation and traffic control), Amazon CloudFront (CDN), AWS KMS (key management), AWS IAM (identity and access management), AWS Config (configuration management), Amazon GuardDuty (threat detection and security monitoring), and Amazon Bedrock and Amazon SageMaker (generative AI processing and machine learning model training and deployment).
Google Workspace. Single sign-on (SSO) and authentication provider for in-scope systems.
Mycroft GRC Platform (Mycroft Technologies Inc). Compliance automation software used by Flare to support the design, implementation, operation, monitoring, and documentation of internal controls.
